_help: The photo galleries on the page are built from this file: the pastry case (bakery), cakes and celebrations, and drinks (coffee).
name: the short caption on the photo. alt: what the photo shows, read aloud by screen readers. English (en) and Spanish (es) side by side; edit both.
file: path of the web photo WITHOUT size or extension. tools/make-photos.py writes four files from the original: name-800.jpg/.webp (the tile) and name-1600.jpg/.webp (the full-size view).
original: the full-size photo in lolita-bakery/photos/. crop (optional): [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the photo, used by tools/make-photos.py.
pos (optional): which part of the photo stays in view when a tile crops it, like "50% 30%" (left-right, top-bottom).
Order here = order on the page. To add a photo: put the original in lolita-bakery/photos/, add a block here, then run python3 tools/make-photos.py.
